title: Quick Fix Yeasty Ethiopian Almond Milk Kadhai
description: A lacto-vegetarian dish that combines the flavors of Ethiopia with a yeasty and tender twist, all made possible by using almond milk and dashi-extract in a kadhai.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the almond milk, yeast, and dashi-extract. Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes, or until it becomes frothy.
Add the flour, ghee or oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, curry powder, and salt to the bowl. Mix well until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased kadhai and cook over medium heat for 10-12 minutes, or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the dough over and cook for another 5-7 minutes, or until it is cooked through and the other side is also golden brown.
Transfer the kadhai to a wire rack and let it cool for 2-3 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a salad for a complete meal.
This dish can be made in under 30 minutes, making it perfect for a weeknight dinner.
This recipe is lacto-vegetarian friendly, making it a great option for those who follow a vegetarian diet.
